images.prompt: High-resolution wide-angle photograph of a cluster of eight HDPE floating net cage aquaculture units arranged in two rows of four on a large tropical Indonesian reservoir at early morning, calm glass-like water surface with soft mist rising from the lake, lush green tropical hillside and mountains visible in the background slightly obscured by morning haze, HDPE frames painted dark navy blue or black with orange safety buoys at corners, green aquaculture nets visible just below the clear water surface, soft diffused golden-hour light from the left casting gentle long shadows across the water, several wooden access walkways connecting cage units, a small simple bamboo shelter on one raft, realistic photorealistic aquaculture trade publication style, wide panoramic composition with cages occupying lower two-thirds and sky-hill reflection in water, 16:9 aspect ratio, no text overlays, no watermarks, no logos, no signatures, no dead fish, no garbage, no algae bloom, no people.
images.alt_id: Deretan unit keramba jaring apung HDPE di waduk Indonesia saat pagi dengan kabut tipis dan perbukitan hijau
images.alt_en: Cluster of HDPE floating net cage aquaculture units on an Indonesian reservoir at sunrise with misty green hills
images.caption_id: Deretan keramba jaring apung (KJA) berbahan HDPE di danau atau waduk menjadi sistem budidaya yang memanfaatkan tubuh air alami — menekan biaya instalasi air dibanding tambak darat. Perhatikan jarak antar rakit yang sesuai SNI 8175:2015 untuk menjaga sirkulasi air.
images.caption_en: An HDPE floating net cage cluster on an Indonesian inland reservoir illustrates how cage systems exploit natural water bodies, eliminating the pumping and water-treatment costs of land-based ponds. Proper spacing between rafts — a minimum of 2 metres between separate units — is mandated by SNI 8175:2015 to maintain water circulation.
images.fallback_note: FLUX handles wide-angle water + landscape scenes well. If output lacks realism in cage structure detail (HDPE pipe joints, net mesh depth), a Shutterstock search for 'floating net cage Indonesia reservoir' or 'keramba jaring apung Jatiluhur' is a reliable swap.

images.concept: Infografis breakdown modal 4 lubang KJA dengan ilustrasi komponen frame, pelampung, jaring, jangkar, dan label biaya per komponen — flat design palet biru-hijau
images.prompt: Clean modern flat-design infographic illustration showing a breakdown of capital investment components for a four-cage floating net cage aquaculture setup, arranged as a horizontal bar chart or grouped icon layout on white background. Seven labeled component blocks with relative proportions: the largest block represents feed costs (approximately half), followed by a medium block for HDPE frame and flotation, medium block for aquaculture nets, small block for fingerling seed stock, small block for anchors and mooring lines, small block for labor and operations, and smallest block for contingency reserve. Each block is a clean flat-design rectangle with a simple outline icon above it: feed block has a small pellet-bag icon, frame block has a hexagonal HDPE pipe icon, nets block has a net mesh diamond icon, fingerling block has a small fish fry silhouette, anchor block has an anchor icon, operations block has a person-wrench icon, contingency block has a shield icon. Aquaculture color palette: deep teal for the largest bar, graduating through medium blue, soft aqua-green, light sky blue, and pale mint for smaller bars. All icons are simple clean line-art. No text, no numbers, no letters, no labels in the image. White background, generous whitespace, 16:9 aspect ratio, professional infographic style. No watermarks, no logos, no signatures.
images.alt_id: Infografis proporsi komponen modal KJA 4 lubang: pakan mendominasi diikuti frame HDPE, jaring, benih, jangkar, operasional, dan cadangan
images.alt_en: Proportional infographic of four-cage KJA capital components: feed dominates, followed by HDPE frame, nets, fingerlings, anchors, operations, and contingency
images.caption_id: Struktur modal awal KJA 4 lubang standar: pakan siklus pertama menyumbang 50–60% total biaya, menegaskan bahwa pilihan dan disiplin pemberian pakan adalah penentu utama profitabilitas. Frame HDPE lebih mahal di muka namun lebih ekonomis dalam total biaya kepemilikan 10 tahun.
images.caption_en: Capital structure for a four-cage standard KJA: first-cycle feed accounts for 50–60% of total outlay, confirming that feed selection and feeding discipline are the primary profitability levers. HDPE frames carry a higher upfront cost but deliver lower total cost of ownership over a 10-year horizon.
images.fallback_note: Prompt deliberately excludes all text/numbers from the image since FLUX and gpt-image-1 both render infographic text unreliably. The article body table carries the precise Rp figures; this image illustrates proportions only via icon+color blocks. If FLUX output looks like abstract art rather than a recognisable bar chart, fall back to a hand-drawn SVG or ask a designer to produce a simple Canva chart.

images.concept: Ilustrasi konseptual upwelling — cross-section danau menunjukkan lapisan air panas di atas dan air dingin anoksik di bawah yang terbalik akibat angin, ikon ikan dan tanda bahaya
images.prompt: Clean scientific educational illustration in cross-section diagram style showing lake upwelling phenomenon in a freshwater volcanic lake used for fish cage aquaculture. Vertical cross-section of a deep lake showing distinct water column layers: the upper warm oxygenated layer (epilimnion) shown in clear blue-green with small dissolved oxygen bubble icons, a middle thermocline transition zone shown in slightly darker blue, and the deep cold anoxic hypolimnion bottom layer shown in dark murky grey-green with small hydrogen sulfide or low-oxygen icons. Large curved white wind arrows blowing across the lake surface from right to left, causing the cold dark bottom water to overturn and rise upward along the left side of the diagram in an upwelling plume (shown as dark grey-green water column rising). Several floating net cage aquaculture units visible at the water surface above the upwelling zone, shown as simple rectangular HDPE cage outlines. Multiple small fish silhouettes near the surface showing stress response or upside-down mortality posture due to oxygen depletion. A simple circular warning icon or red exclamation marker above the upwelling zone. Color coding: warm surface water in bright teal-blue, cold anoxic water in dark grey-green, upwelling plume in muted olive-grey, cage outlines in navy, wind arrows in clean white. Flat educational illustration style reminiscent of textbook or KKP educational poster, clean line art with semi-transparent color fills, 16:9 aspect ratio, no text labels in the image, no watermarks, no logos, no signatures.
images.alt_id: Diagram cross-section danau menunjukkan lapisan air panas teroksigenasi di atas dan lapisan anoksik dingin yang membalik ke permukaan saat upwelling
images.alt_en: Lake cross-section diagram showing warm oxygenated epilimnion above cold anoxic hypolimnion inverting to the surface during an upwelling event
images.caption_id: Mekanisme upwelling di danau dalam: angin kencang memicu pembalikan lapisan air, mendorong massa air dingin anoksik dari dasar ke permukaan dalam hitungan jam. Ketika lapisan ini mencapai keramba, oksigen terlarut bisa anjlok dari 6 ppm ke di bawah 2 ppm — ambang batas kematian ikan. Kejadian Danau Maninjau Desember 2025 (1.428,73 ton nila mati) adalah contoh terakhir dari risiko berulang ini.
images.caption_en: The mechanics of deep-lake upwelling: strong wind forces cold anoxic bottom water upward toward the surface within hours. When this layer reaches the cage zone, dissolved oxygen can collapse from 6 ppm to below 2 ppm — the mortality threshold. The Lake Maninjau event of December 2025, which killed 1,428.73 tonnes of harvest-ready tilapia, is the most recent instance of this recurring risk.
images.fallback_note: Scientific cross-section diagrams with precise layered water-column structure and accurate spatial relationships are difficult for FLUX and gpt-image-1. The most common failure modes are: layers rendered as decorative bands rather than a coherent water-column cross-section, cage outlines that look like boxes floating on sky, and upwelling plume indistinguishable from background water. Recommended fallback: commission a Boyd-style educational diagram from a technical illustrator, or use the KKP/BMKG upwelling infographic (verify copyright before use). Alternatively, a clear editorial photograph of mass fish mortality at the water surface (source: Antara/Mongabay archives from the December 2025 Maninjau event) would be equally effective for editorial impact, subject to licensing.
